summary.goal: Mission Control dashboard for run monitoring, gate approvals, trajectory exploration, and question queue management. Provides visibility into Forge execution for humans overseeing agent work.
scope_in: Run dashboard showing progress, active agents, pending gates
Pre-flight check view before starting runs
Gate approval interface with artifact review
Active agent cards with status and messages
Status bar integration for at-a-glance monitoring
Agent question queue for blocking questions

acceptance_criteria.description: User can see list of runs with status filters (running, completed, failed)
User can view run dashboard showing real-time progress via SSE
User can review pre-flight check before starting a run
User can approve/reject gates with artifact review and optional notes
User can view run timeline showing all events
User can see active agents and their current status
User can view and click through to artifacts (PRs, deployments)
Status bar shows active run progress at a glance
User can answer agent questions from queue

observations: Follows Mission Control design system from planner-ui
Gate approvals are the primary human interaction point
Timeline enables post-run debugging and audit
patterns: Same tech stack as planner-ui (React, Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui)
Reuse design system components from planner-ui

observations: ASCII wireframes in design doc define the layouts
Pre-flight → Dashboard → Timeline is the user journey
Notifications for gates are critical (can't miss approvals)
Agent cards show context without overwhelming

architect.tech_stack: TypeScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui
architect.component_reuse: Extend planner-ui design system and patterns

summary.goal: Base layout with navigation, routing, and shared components for Forge UI

acceptance_criteria.description: App shell with sidebar navigation
Routes: /forge (runs list), /forge/runs/:id (dashboard), /forge/runs/:id/timeline
Shared API client for Forge endpoints
SSE connection management hook
Theme integration with Mission Control design system

summary.goal: List all runs with status filtering, search, and quick actions

acceptance_criteria.description: Table/card list of runs showing status, plan name, duration
Filter by status: all, running, completed, failed, paused
Click to navigate to run dashboard
Import Plan button to create new run
Real-time status updates via SSE

summary.goal: Main view during execution showing progress, tasks, and agents

acceptance_criteria.description: Progress bar with task counts (X/Y completed)
Task list showing status icons, titles, durations, artifacts
Active agents section with current task info
Run controls: Pause, Resume, Cancel
Real-time updates via SSE subscription
Gate pending indicator with notification

summary.goal: Review plan and configuration before starting execution

acceptance_criteria.description: Plan summary (goal, step count, estimated time)
Pre-flight checklist (repos accessible, roles mapped, gates identified)
Environment selector if multiple configured
Start Forging button to begin execution
Cancel to return without starting

summary.goal: Interface for humans to approve or reject gates with full context

acceptance_criteria.description: Gate details: step title, description, verification results
Artifacts list with links (PRs, reports, deployments)
Optional notes field for approval/rejection
Approve and Reject buttons with confirmation
Notification badge when gate is pending

summary.goal: Audit log showing all events in chronological order

acceptance_criteria.description: Chronological list of all run events with timestamps
Event types: task started/completed/failed, agent spawned, gate resolved
Filter by event type
Export log button
Link artifacts to timeline entries

summary.goal: Visual cards showing active agents and their current status

acceptance_criteria.description: Card per active agent with role icon and name
Current task title displayed
Latest status message from agent
View Details link to expanded view
Real-time updates as agent reports progress

summary.goal: Display and link to artifacts produced by the run

acceptance_criteria.description: List artifacts by type (PR, commit, deployment, file)
External links open in new tab (GitHub, deployment URL)
Associated task shown for each artifact
Status badge (merged, open, deployed)

summary.goal: Status bar showing active run progress at a glance

acceptance_criteria.description: Progress indicator (4/7 tasks) in status bar
Active agent count with status dots
Pending gates indicator
Elapsed time display
Click to expand full run dashboard

summary.goal: Interface for answering agent questions that are blocking execution

acceptance_criteria.description: Queue showing pending questions from agents
Question context: which agent, which task, urgency
Response options or free-form input
Notification when new question arrives
Question type badges (blocking, preference, FYI)
